in_arabic.name: قيامة
in_arabic.meaning: القيامة هي حقيقة دينية واضحة، ومعناها هو الموت والبعث، والإيمان بأن الله يبعث جميع الناس بعد الموت.
in_arabic.long_meaning: القيامة هي أحد أهم العقائد الإسلامية، ويعتقد المسلمون بأن الله سيعيدهم بعد الموت، ويحاسبهم على أعمالهم، ويجزيهم بالنعيم أو العذاب. وتشير الاية القرآنية (يوم تُبعَث كل أنثى عَمياء) إلى القيامة، وتشير إلى أن الله سيعيدهم جميعاً، وسيجزيهم وفقاً لما صنعوا. وتعتبر القيامة حقيقة دينية واضحة، ومعناها هو الموت والبعث، والإيمان بأن الله يبعث جميع الناس بعد الموت.

in_urdu.name: قیامہ
in_urdu.meaning: قیامہ کا معنی ہے اٹھنا اور دوبارہ پیدا ہونا، یہ ایک ایسا عمل ہے جس میں تمام انسان مابعد موت کی زندگی میں واپس آتے ہیں۔
in_urdu.long_meaning: قیامہ ایک اہم اسلامی عقیدہ ہے جس کے مطابق الله نے تمام انسانوں کو دوبارہ اٹھانا ہے، اور انہیں ان کے اعمال کے مطابق جزا دی جائے گی۔ یہ عقیدہ کورآن کے مختلف آیات میں مذکور ہے جیسے (یوم تُبعَث كل أنثى عَمياء) اور (يوم تُبعَث كل النّاس)۔

in_hindi.name: क़ियामह
in_hindi.meaning: क़ियामह का अर्थ है मृत्यु के बाद जीवित होना, या पुनर्जीवन होना, जिसमें सभी लोगों का पुनर्जीवन होता है।
in_hindi.long_meaning: क़ियामह एक महत्वपूर्ण इस्लामी विश्वास है, जिसके अनुसार अल्लाह सभी लोगों को पुनर्जीवित करेगा, और उन्हें उनके कर्मों के अनुसार पुरस्कृत या दंडित करेगा। कोरान की विभिन्न आयतों में इसका उल्लेख है, जैसे कि (योम त्बعषكل अन्थिय अमया) और (योम त्बعष كل नास)।

in_pashto.name: قیامہ
in_pashto.meaning: قیامہ دا معنا دی دسیږو چی په هغه ورځ کې څوک یوازې مرګ نه کوی بلکې ځانګړي ځایونو ته ګیږي، ترڅو په دې ځایونو کې دوی د خپلو اعمالو په بنسټ دېدلي بهوډلي شي.
in_pashto.long_meaning: قیامہ د اسلامي عقیدو یوه ځانګړې برخه ده، کوم چې د ځانګړو عقیدو په ډول اسلامي عقیدې ته اړونده ده. ددې عقیدې په اساس الله د خپلو بندگو په مخې ډیریو ځانګړو ځایونو ته د دوی د مرګ په وروسته راونګول کوي او د دوی د اعمالو په بنسټ بهوډلی کوي.

in_english.name: Qiyamah
in_english.meaning: Qiyamah is a Quranic term that refers to the resurrection of all people after death, and the belief that Allah will resurrect and judge all individuals based on their deeds.
in_english.long_meaning: Qiyamah is an important Islamic doctrine that refers to the resurrection of all people after death, and the belief that Allah will resurrect and judge all individuals based on their deeds. The Quran mentions Qiyamah in several verses, such as (Youth of the people will be raised) and (The Day when all people will be resurrected). Qiyamah is a fundamental concept in Islam, and it emphasizes the importance of living a righteous life and preparing for the afterlife.

data.cultural_impact: The Islamic name "Qiyamah" holds a deep cultural significance in the Muslim world. It is a symbol of the end of time, the final judgment, and the struggle for the hereafter. It is often depicted in Islamic art and literature as a powerful and awe-inspiring event. The concept of Qiyamah is a reminder of the importance of living a virtuous life and striving for justice and righteousness in society. It is a unifying force that brings Muslims together in anticipation of the Day of Judgment.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the Day of Judgment, symbolized by the name Qiyamah, holds immense spiritual significance. It is believed that on this day, every action committed in life will be weighed in the balance of justice. This day marks the end of the transient world and the beginning of eternal life in either Paradise or Hell. The spiritual significance of Qiyamah motivates Muslims to strive for righteousness and avoid evil acts, as they believe that the rewards of good deeds in the hereafter are far greater than those in the material world.

historical_references.reference: The Day of Judgement or Qiyamah is an integral part of Islamic eschatology and is believed to occur after the death of the last prophet Muhammad. This belief is based on various hadiths and verses from the Quran.

The concept of Qiyamah was developed in the early Islamic community and was influenced by Jewish and Christian eschatological beliefs. The Islamic belief in the resurrection of the dead, Judgement Day, and the Day of Reckoning are all closely related to this concept.

modern_usage.modern_context: The Islamic concept of Qiyamah, also known as the Day of Judgment or the Last Judgment, refers to the end of the world and the final reckoning of all human souls. This belief is an integral part of Islamic theology and eschatology, and is mentioned frequently in the Quran and Hadith. In modern times, the concept of Qiyamah has gained significant attention on various platforms. People often discuss and debate the signs of Qiyamah, as mentioned in Islamic prophecies, on social media, in mosques, and in academic circles. Some believe that we are living in the final days, while others argue that the signs of Qiyamah are still far in the future. Overall, the belief in Qiyamah continues to be a source of inspiration, reflection, and community among Muslims around the world.
